plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, METU, MUU) to zero.
Trim QQQI to 20% and SPY to 15% to reduce concentration.
Buy XOM as a stable energy holding.
This plan prioritizes capital preservation.
Expect lower volatility and modest growth.
Cash buffer will increase significantly.
conservative.read: This conservative approach aims for capital preservation with modest growth, targeting around 1.5% per month. It significantly reduces leverage and concentrates on less volatile assets, aiming for lower drawdowns. However, growth potential is also capped.

plan: Trim leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, METU, MUU) to low single digits.
Reduce QQQI and SPY exposure to 20% each.
Buy XOM as a new, stable position.
This plan balances risk reduction with growth opportunities.
It aims for steady, risk-first growth.
Cash buffer will be around 10%.
balanced.read: This balanced plan seeks risk-first growth, targeting approximately 2.5% per month. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while adding a stable energy position. The focus is on a diversified approach with controlled risk. Upside is moderate, and drawdowns are expected to be manageable.

plan: Increase exposure to leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, METU, MUU).
Trim QQQI and SPY to 15% each to allow for concentration.
Buy XOM as a new, stable position.
This plan aggressively pursues growth through leverage and concentration.
Expect higher potential returns but also significantly larger drawdowns.
Strict stop discipline is crucial due to increased risk and leverage decay.
aggressive.read: This aggressive growth plan targets approximately 4% per month by increasing leverage and concentrating on high-potential (and high-risk) assets, including leveraged ETFs. It accepts significantly higher potential drawdowns and the risk of rapid losses, especially with leveraged ETFs. Strict adherence to stops is paramount.

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, METU, MUU) and high-growth tech (CRWD, SNOW).
Increase QQQI to 30% to maximize income generation.
This plan prioritizes steady monthly income over growth.
It aims for low drawdowns and reliable distributions.
Leverage will be minimized.
Expect modest returns primarily from income distributions, not capital appreciation.
income.read: This income-focused plan targets approximately 1% per month by shifting to income-generating assets like QQQI and reducing volatile holdings. It prioritizes capital preservation and consistent monthly distributions over aggressive growth. While aiming for low drawdowns, the Net Asset Value can still decline in market downturns.
